binaries.rule: tracked basenames exactly bb/bbh; exact pyproject entrypoint; operation manifest rows

e4_ast.rule: AST Call with final attribute add_parser; literal_count requires first positional argument to be a string literal

main_ast.rule: AST Call with final attribute add_parser; literal_count requires first positional argument to be a string literal

cli.rule: recursively count the argparse root and every registered subparser with all feature flags absent; add the single exact pyproject breadboard entry point; legacy/local counts are AST If declaration sites for their exact flags; E4 count is the recursive parser-node delta with only BREADBOARD_ENABLE_E4_API=1

compatibility.rule: exact compatibility subclass plus every row in the two authoritative registries; nondefault IDs are lifecycle rows with default_for_generation false

durable_reconfigure.rule: one row per source line containing the exact word token in tracked product roots; classify def/typed parameter as definition, call as invocation, 'is None' as guard, and remaining references as wiring

event_kinds.rule: EventType string assignments in cli_bridge/events.py; exact keys of the three named session_state mappings; every kernel_event_kinds registry row

http_routes.rule: AST function decorators whose final attribute is one of HTTP_METHODS; scan only breadboard_engine/api/**/*.py and breadboard/product/**/*.py; denominator is all tracked breadboard_engine/**/*.py

omp_adapters.rule: all git ls-files paths under exact repository-root .omp/ prefix

profiles_and_lanes.rule: git ls-files exact prefixes; YAML=.yaml/.yml; JSON=.json

projections.rule: each exact symbol must occur in its pinned tracked owner path

repository_surfaces.rule: git ls-files paths with exact prefix; each tracked path once

sdk_exports.rule: literal breadboard_sdk.__all__; operation manifest rows; public-client method declarations named invoke; exact generated-index lines beginning 'export type '

tui_consumers.rule: tracked .ts/.tsx files under ENGINE tui_skeleton/src; tracked .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx files under TUI packages/coding-agent/src; exclude any path component in TUI_EXCLUDED_PARTS; count each file once when an exact @breadboard/sdk module literal matches

methods.deduplication: tracked paths once; HTTP decorators once per AST node; durable token once per source line; registry and manifest rows once per array row

schema_tiers.rule: every contract_tiers entry grouped by exact pair; tracked .json paths under exact schema roots
